title: Embedded Systems Design Lab Tutor
bullets: Led 3 lab sections a week with 1-2 other tutors
Assisted around 20 students each section by answering questions and providing debugging advice
Taught students how to debug hardware with Oscilloscopes, Multimeters, LEDs, and LCD screens
Communicated effectively and concisely to ensure every student received assistance before the section ended
Helped students understand and use concepts such as RTOS, UART, DMA, ADC, DAC, PWM, etc
Performed check-offs and graded lab submissions while cross-referencing colleagues to ensure equal and fair grading among students
